purpose: Read-only planning of candidate-intake drafts from observed deployment drift without creating pending review candidates.
draftRule: The observed release commit must differ from the currently reviewed commit.
The observed Defence-profile blob must exactly equal the reviewed profile blob before reviewed profileVersion and policies may be reused.
The app must not already have a pending_review candidate.
The draft intake payload contains evidence as an empty array and is never valid candidate-intake-v1 input until bounded review evidence is added.
Deployment observations are provenance for the draft identity, not review evidence.

draftStates.meaning: Release/profile identity is safely prefilled but at least one bounded review-evidence record is still required.
The observed profile blob differs from the reviewed profile, so policies/profileVersion cannot be inherited automatically.
The app already has an active review candidate; no second intake draft is actionable.

materialization: A planner draft may be materialized only after review evidence has been explicitly supplied.
Materialization produces an ordinary candidate-intake-v1 JSON payload and reuses the canonical candidate-intake validator.
The planner itself never writes review-candidates-v1.
nonClaims: Deployment drift is not evidence that a release is unsafe.
A generated draft is not a review candidate.
Deployment observation metadata is not a substitute for code/security review evidence.
Profile-drift releases require refreshed profile claims before intake can be planned automatically.
